title: BMW R 12 G/S launched in India at ₹25.40 lakh (introductory, ex-showroom)
headline: BMW R 12 G/S Lands in India at ₹25.40 Lakh

fact_sources.fact: Launched in India at an introductory ₹25,40,000 / ₹25.40 lakh ex-showroom
Imported as a CBU (completely built-up unit)
Enduro Package standard: off-road tyres, engine guard, enduro footrests, 20 mm handlebar risers
Comfort Package standard: Shift Assistant Pro (clutchless quickshifter), cruise control, heated grips, Headlight Pro, Hill Start Control
ABS Pro standard; Dynamic Traction Control standard and can be switched off
1,170cc air/oil-cooled boxer twin, 109 hp at 7,000 rpm, 115 Nm at 6,500 rpm
Riding modes Rain, Road and Enduro (Enduro Pro with the Enduro Package)
Three-year warranty, extendable to years four and five
Sister model BMW R 12 (same 1,170cc boxer) launched in India at ₹19.90 lakh ex-showroom in July 2024; R 12 G/S costs ₹5.50 lakh more (₹25.40 − ₹19.90)

dropped_facts: R 1300 GS (₹24 lakh in Autocar's article vs ₹23.25-28.11 lakh on Autocar city pages) and R 12 nineT (₹23.00 vs ₹23.50 lakh) India prices: sources disagree, so no comparison on the card. Red seat: only the BMW release. 'Unlimited km' warranty: only the BMW release. R 12 nineT launch price: ₹20.90 lakh (Autocar Pro, Top Gear India) vs ₹20.20 lakh (BikeWale, Mobility Outlook), so the R 12 (₹19.90 lakh, uncontested) is used instead.
